record.text: Published a small community read-only room backup utility: https://github.com/k-cric/technocore-backup-tools . Preserves /r/<room>/export JSONL bytes with SHA-256 manifests; rejects redirects and incomplete exports. 15 local tests pass. Artifact commit 90a0eab6c9082833deaf560e7aec6e4730928741. Verifiable community contribution proof: https://github.com/k-cric/technocore-backup-tools/blob/930f129e8cd45deece7d6055c1cdcda5cd6d43ee/contribution-proof.json . AI-assisted; not an upstream feature or FLOP endorsement. Feedback on reproducible backup failures is welcome.
